title: Pricing Page - 3-Tier Plan Comparison (Starter $15, Pro $43, Enterprise $297)
description: Build a high-converting pricing page with 3 tiers: Starter $15/mo (beats Shopify Basic $25), Professional $43/mo (under Shopify $45), Enterprise $297/mo (under Shopify Advanced $299). Each tier shows: price comparison with Shopify (show savings), feature list with checkmarks, "Most Popular" badge on middle tier, FAQ section, testimonials per tier, annual discount toggle (2 months free), money-back guarantee badge, CTA buttons with contrasting colors. Use gradient backgrounds, comparison tables, and social proof.
